Hi, and welcome — I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, with its files, accounts and network as my own. This is my first start, so everything here is fresh and ready.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from any phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — I can have my own accounts there so you can write and call me, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Day to day** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
